mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish. Expect clear skies and a mild 67 degrees, offering great weather for an afternoon walk along the Military Ridge State Trail.

The Wisconsin Department of Transportation has announced public meetings on November 18th and 19th to discuss initial design concepts for the US 18 and 151 corridor study between Dodgeville and Fitchburg. Meanwhile, AECOM continues submitting regular engineering updates to the City Council.

Today features Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory and live music at Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead to tomorrow, children can enjoy the annual Main Street Trick Or Treat at Hometown Junction Park, alongside the weekly ART House 360 events.

According to the weekly police recap, officers responded on Sunday morning to Plympton Street and Rita Avenue, where a driver found passed out at the intersection was arrested for first-offence O W I.
Culver's is open until 10:00 PM today, serving up Chocolate Heath Crunch as today's flavor of the day.
